snippet.title: DeadShare- Sixfold The Game Official Reveal
snippet.description:
Welcome to SIXFOLD, the game show nobody admits watching. Six contestants, six electric chairs, one room under Capital City, and a broadcast that goes out live whatever happens in it. Tonight is the final round.

DeadShare is a six-player online social deduction game. Every round, everyone secretly picks: attack a seat, counter the one you think is coming for you, or hold and keep your hands clean. All choices land at once. The screen shows who is out. It never shows who did it.

Talk. Bluff. Make deals. Break them. Survive together and split the pot, or walk out alone and take it all.

▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5372230/DeadShare
▶ Sign up for the free playtest: https://sixfoldthegame.com
▶ Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/ZhFBH65yYQ

Coming soon to PC. Built in Unreal Engine 5.

Everybody picks. Nobody tells.
